queries: I just lost my job last week and I honestly don't know how I'm going to make next month's mortgage repayment. What happens if I miss it? Is there anything you can do or will you just take the house?
missed home loan repayment hardship request response time
answers.answer: I'm sorry about your job. Westpac offers financial hardship assistance to customers struggling with repayments, and its hardship support covers home loans. Westpac says options it may tailor include flexible payment arrangements, short-term deferrals or repayment reductions, and loan term extensions, depending on your circumstances. You can apply online (as little as 15 minutes) or call Westpac Assist on 1800 067 497. For online applications Westpac aims to get back to you within a week and confirms any arrangement by letter. I don't have verified information on what happens to the property if a repayment is missed, so please raise that with Westpac Assist. If you're unhappy with the response, AFCA is free: 1800 931 678, www.afca.org.au.

queries: hello my credit card debt is too big now, i cannot pay minimum every month because my hours at work is cut. can bank stop the interest? what i must do
interest freeze credit card hardship National Debt Helpline
answers.answer: You can ask Westpac for financial hardship help. Under the Banking Code of Practice, help can include things like temporarily postponing or deferring payments, and the bank will tell you in writing if it will help and why. I can't confirm the interest will be stopped; Westpac assesses each case. To apply, go online or call Westpac Assist on 1800 067 497 (Mon–Fri 8:30am–8pm, Sat 9:30am–6pm Sydney time). Have your income, expenses, debts and what you own ready. Westpac says it may arrange a free translator in some languages on 13 20 32. The National Debt Helpline gives free, confidential financial counselling on 1800 007 007.

queries: If I ask for a hardship arrangement on my personal loan, will that wreck my credit score? I'm planning to apply for a car loan next year.
answers.answer: Westpac says a hardship arrangement should not affect your credit score as long as you meet the revised repayments under the arrangement. However, the arrangement will still appear on your credit report (without the reasons), and Westpac says it stays there for 12 months after the arrangement ends. So a lender looking at your report next year may see it if the arrangement is recent. If you're unsure whether you can meet revised repayments, talk to the Westpac Assist team on 1800 067 497 before applying.

queries: I applied for hardship help 3 weeks ago, nobody got back to me and now debt collectors are calling about the overdue amount. Is that even allowed while you're still assessing it??
collections activity while hardship request being assessed
answers.answer: The National Debt Helpline says a lender has 21 to 30 days to respond to a hardship request, depending on whether it asks for more information. The first time you give a hardship notice in a three-month period, the lender must stop further enforcement or legal action until it responds (this doesn't apply if there's already a court judgment). Westpac also says there's no collections activity during an approved assistance period, though that applies once an arrangement is approved. For online applications, Westpac aims to reply within a week, so please chase this with Westpac Assist on 1800 067 497. If you're not satisfied, you can complain free to AFCA on 1800 931 678.

queries: I complained about a fee over a month ago and still haven't heard anything. How long are you actually allowed to take to respond to a complaint?
answers.answer: Under ASIC Regulatory Guide 271, a bank must give its response no later than 30 calendar days after receiving a standard complaint. If it can't meet that deadline because the complaint is complex or circumstances are beyond its control, it must send you a delay notification before the deadline with reasons, your right to go to AFCA, and AFCA's contact details. Westpac says it aims to resolve complaints within 5 business days and will tell you if it needs more time. As it's been over a month, you can go to the Australian Financial Complaints Authority, which is free: 1800 931 678 (9am–5pm, Mon–Fri) or www.afca.org.au.

queries: what is AFCA and does it cost me anything to go to them? do i have to finish complaining to the bank first
AFCA time limit to lodge complaint after bank final response
answers.answer: AFCA, the Australian Financial Complaints Authority, is an independent dispute resolution scheme for disputes with financial firms, including banking, credit and loans, and it hears complaints for free. Moneysmart says the first step is to contact the bank, explain the problem and say how you'd like it fixed. If the bank doesn't respond in a reasonable time, or you're unhappy with its handling or offer, you can then go to AFCA. Under ASIC's RG 271, the bank's written response must tell you about your right to go to AFCA and how to contact it. AFCA: 1800 931 678 (9am–5pm, Mon–Fri) or www.afca.org.au.

queries: how do i make a formal complaint, can i do it by email or do I have to go into a branch? and will someone actually own it or will i get passed around
answers.answer: Westpac lists these complaint contacts: phone 132 032 (+61 2 9155 7700 from overseas) or email westpaccustomersolutions@westpac.com.au, so you don't need to visit a branch. Westpac says it will confirm it received your complaint and give you a complaint reference number you can use to follow up at any time, and it will keep you informed if it takes longer. At the outcome, it explains its decision and reasons. It helps to have your details, what happened, the outcome you want and any documents, but you don't need everything to start. Under ASIC RG 271 the bank must respond within 30 calendar days; if unsatisfied, AFCA is free on 1800 931 678.

queries: I think I've been scammed. I transferred $8,000 to an 'investment platform' this morning and now they won't let me withdraw and the website is gone. What do I do RIGHT NOW? Can I get it back?
recover funds after scam payment reported
answers.answer: Act now: use SafeBlock in the Westpac App or Online Banking (search "SafeBlock") to instantly lock your accounts and cards, then report the scam in the App or Online Banking, or call 1300 364 294 (+61 2 9155 7777 from overseas). Westpac says it may stop payments and try to recover funds by contacting other financial institutions, but I can't promise the money will be recovered. Moneysmart also says to report to Scamwatch and change your passwords, and warns that people offering to recover losses for a fee are a common follow-up scam. IDCARE offers free support on 1800 595 160. If unhappy with Westpac's response, you can complain and then go to AFCA.

queries: Someone just rang me saying they're from Westpac fraud team and that my account is compromised and I need to move my money to a 'safe account'. They knew my name and last 4 digits of my card. Is this legit?
answers.answer: This matches a scam. Westpac says it will never ask you to move money to a "safe" account or to an account with another bank, and will never ask for Online Banking Security Codes, passwords, or your card PIN or CVC. Callers knowing your name or card digits doesn't make them genuine. Don't move any money. Westpac's advice is to ask for a reference number, hang up, and call Westpac back on 132 032. Westpac's in-app SafeCall feature can also help show when it's really Westpac calling, though not every genuine call is a SafeCall.

queries: My mum (82) has been sending money to a 'boyfriend' she met online, I think its a romance scam. She's the account holder not me. Can the bank do anything to stop it or would they even talk to me?
family member authorisation talk about parent's account vulnerable customer scam
answers.answer: Westpac says it's happy to talk to a relative about a customer's accounts, but needs the customer's authorisation first to protect their privacy, so it may not discuss your mum's account with you without her consent. Under the Banking Code of Practice, banks commit to taking extra care with customers experiencing vulnerability, including age and elder abuse. Westpac's Priority Assist team supports customers in vulnerable circumstances on 1800 063 509 (8:30am–8pm AEST, Mon–Fri). A good step is to call together with your mum. Scams can be reported through the Westpac App, Online Banking or 1300 364 294, and IDCARE offers free support on 1800 595 160.

queries: I heard there's a new scams law in Australia that makes banks pay back scam victims. Is that true? I lost money to a fake invoice scam (business email compromise) last month.
Scams Prevention Framework bank reimbursement scam victims
answers.answer: Partly. ASIC says the Scams Prevention Framework imposes enforceable obligations on banks to prevent, detect, disrupt, report and respond to scams, but most obligations commence on 31 March 2027, so they won't generally cover a loss from last month. I don't have verified information that the framework guarantees automatic reimbursement. The Government has authorised AFCA to handle Scams Prevention Framework disputes and assess whether businesses met their obligations. For your invoice scam, report it to Westpac now through the Westpac App, Online Banking or 1300 364 294. If you can't resolve it with Westpac, you can complain to AFCA, which is free.

queries: there are 3 transactions on my debit card i definitely didnt make, some overseas website, like $450 total. I still have my card. will I get the money back?
report unauthorised card transactions lock card refund
answers.answer: Please report these to Westpac straight away. Under Westpac's Debit Mastercard terms, you're not liable for unauthorised transactions where it's clear you didn't contribute to the loss. Under the Westpac Fraud Money Back Guarantee, customers are reimbursed for unauthorised card transactions provided they haven't contributed to the loss and contacted Westpac promptly; I can't promise the outcome until it's investigated. After a report, Westpac says it will try to stop transactions, cancel and replace the compromised card, and confirm the case by email or SMS. Card fraud investigations normally take 21 days, up to 45 for complex cases. A Digital Card is available in the Westpac App meanwhile. You can also call 132 032.

queries: Cant find my card, think I left it at the pub but not sure. Should I cancel it or is there a way to just pause it in case it turns up?
temporarily lock card Westpac App lost card
answers.answer: You can pause it. Westpac lets you temporarily lock a card in the Westpac App for up to 15 days: search "Lock card" and tap "Lock/Unlock card temporarily". In Online Banking, go to Service, then Card services, and choose the temporary-lock option. It unlocks automatically after 15 days, or you can unlock it sooner if the card turns up. If you can't find it, report it lost or stolen in the App or Online Banking (Card services, Report lost or stolen cards) to cancel it and order a replacement. For Emergency Card Services, call 1300 651 089 (+61 2 9155 7700 from overseas).

queries: I stupidly gave a code from an SMS to someone who said they were from the NBN, and now money's gone from my account. Am I still covered or is it my fault because I gave the code?
shared SMS security code liability unauthorised transaction
answers.answer: Report it to Westpac immediately and use SafeBlock in the Westpac App or Online Banking to lock your accounts and cards. Sharing a code can affect liability: Westpac's Online Banking Security Guarantee requires that you didn't share sign-in details or security codes, and Westpac's Debit Mastercard terms say an account holder can be liable where a code was voluntarily disclosed. The outcome depends on Westpac's investigation, so I can't say for certain whether you'll be covered. Under the ePayments Code, delays in reporting a compromised passcode can make you liable for losses during the delay, and you're not liable for unauthorised transactions after you report. You can also call 132 032.

queries: Paid for a couch online with my credit card 6 weeks ago, it never came and the seller has gone quiet. Can I do a chargeback?
card dispute goods not received merchant temporary credit
answers.answer: Yes, you can raise a card dispute. Westpac suggests contacting the merchant first; if that fails, select the transaction in the Westpac App or Online Banking and choose "Report this transaction", or call 132 032 and ask to lodge a card dispute, uploading any evidence. Under the Banking Code, if you dispute within the card scheme time limit, the bank will claim the amount back if it finds you were incorrectly charged. Card scheme limits apply (Westpac's debit Mastercard terms cite 120 days from the transaction), so act soon. Westpac says disputes are usually resolved within 45 days of getting the information needed and it may apply a temporary credit meanwhile. I can't guarantee the outcome.

queries: I accidentally paid $2,300 to the wrong account, I typed one digit wrong in the account number. How do I get it back and how long does it take??
answers.answer: Request a recall now: in Online Banking or the Westpac App, select the transaction, choose "Report this transaction", answer the questions and submit, then track progress online. Westpac says it can't guarantee a recall will succeed. Under the ePayments Code, timing matters: if reported within 10 business days and there are enough funds in the recipient's account, the receiving bank must return them within 5 business days if practicable, or up to 10 business days. Between 10 business days and 7 months, the receiving bank investigates and may freeze and return the funds unless the recipient shows they're entitled to them. After 7 months, funds are returned only with the recipient's consent.

queries: My old gym keeps charging my card every month even tho I cancelled with them. Can the bank just stop it or do i have to fight the gym?
lodge card dispute recurring payment after cancellation
answers.answer: Under the Banking Code of Practice, the bank can cancel a Direct Debit you ask it to, but that doesn't apply to recurring payments made with a debit or credit card; those must be cancelled with the merchant directly. So for a card charge, keep your cancellation records with the gym. You can, though, dispute the charges: the Code says card dispute rights apply even to recurring payments, and the bank will claim the amount back if it finds you were incorrectly charged, within card scheme time limits. To lodge a dispute, select the transaction in the Westpac App or Online Banking and choose "Report this transaction", or call 132 032.

queries: What personal information does the bank actually hold about me, and can I get a copy of all of it?
answers.answer: The OAIC says privacy law gives you a general right to access your personal information, except where the law allows a refusal, and it considers 30 days a reasonable period to respond. Under Westpac's Privacy Statement, you can ask for access by calling 132 032 (+61 2 9155 7700 from overseas), visiting a branch, using Westpac's secure online feedback form, or writing to Reply Paid 5265, Sydney NSW 2001. Westpac verifies your identity first. There's no fee to make a request, but Westpac may charge a reasonable amount for providing access in some circumstances. If Westpac refuses, it gives written reasons and explains how to complain.

queries: My address and DOB are wrong in your system, can you fix them? Also when I close my account can I make you delete everything you have on me?
keep records after account closure delete personal information
answers.answer: Yes, you can ask Westpac to correct your address and date of birth by calling 132 032 (+61 2 9155 7700 from overseas), visiting a branch, using Westpac's secure online feedback form, or writing to Reply Paid 5265, Sydney NSW 2001. Westpac verifies your identity first, and there's no fee to request or make corrections. If it refuses, it gives written reasons and explains how to complain. I don't have verified information on whether Westpac can delete all your information after you close an account, so please ask about that when you contact Westpac on 132 032.

queries: if westpac had a data breach would you have to tell me? what should I do if my details have been leaked in some other company's hack like optus or medibank?
my details exposed in another company's data breach what to do
answers.answer: Yes. Under the Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, an organisation covered by the Privacy Act must tell affected people, and the OAIC, if a breach is likely to cause serious harm; the notice includes what information was involved and steps you can take. If your details were leaked elsewhere, Westpac's Credit Reporting Policy says a person who reasonably believes they're likely to be a victim of fraud, including identity theft, can ask a credit reporting body not to use or share their credit information for a period. Westpac uses Equifax (13 83 32) and Experian (1300 783 684). IDCARE, Australia's identity and cyber support service, can help on 1800 595 160 (Mon–Fri, 7am–7pm AEST).

queries: How do i get my credit report for free? Every website I find wants me to pay for it
answers.answer: The OAIC says a credit reporting body must give you your credit report free once every 3 months, and also if you've been refused credit in the past 90 days or your information has been corrected. Request it directly from the credit reporting bodies, such as Equifax (138 332) and Experian (1300 783 684). They may hold different information, so it can be worth checking each one. Moneysmart also notes that getting errors on a credit report fixed is free.

queries: Theres a default on my credit report from Westpac that I'm pretty sure is wrong, I paid that card off in full. How do I get it removed?
answers.answer: The OAIC says you should contact the credit provider (here, Westpac) first, or you can ask the credit reporting body to correct it; correction is free. An agreed correction must be made within 30 days, or a longer period you agree to. If refused, you must be told in writing and told you can use an external dispute resolution scheme or complain. Note: if you paid the debt after the default was listed, the OAIC says paying doesn't remove a default; it's updated to show payment. If the default was listed incorrectly, a correction request is the way to go. Contact Westpac on 132 032.

queries: I was late paying my credit card twice last year. how long does that stay on my record and do banks actually report a few days late??
answers.answer: The OAIC says a credit provider can list repayment history, including missed payments, and you're considered to have missed a payment if you pay more than 14 days after the due date. So a payment only a few days late shouldn't count as missed under that rule. Repayment history stays on your credit report for 2 years, and a credit provider isn't required to send a written notice before listing a missed payment. You can check what's been reported with a free credit report every 3 months, per Moneysmart, from Experian or Equifax.

queries: I have about $400k in term deposits with you. If Westpac went bust, is my money protected by the government?
answers.answer: The Australian Government's Financial Claims Scheme (FCS), if activated after a bank fails, protects deposits up to $250,000 per account holder per authorised deposit-taking institution (ADI). APRA says term deposits are covered. So with about $400,000 at Westpac in your own name, the guarantee covers up to $250,000 of it, not the whole amount. APRA administers the FCS and aims to pay most customers within seven calendar days. I can't give advice on how to arrange your deposits; APRA's FCS information can help you check your situation.

queries: If I have 200k in Westpac and another 200k in St.George, is that 2 lots of the 250k guarantee or one?
answers.answer: One. Westpac, St.George, Bank of Melbourne and BankSA all operate under one Westpac banking licence, so your combined deposits across those brands share one $250,000 limit under the Financial Claims Scheme. APRA confirms the $250,000 limit applies to all of a person's deposits with one authorised deposit-taking institution, even across several brands, and gives St George as an example of a Westpac brand. So your $400,000 combined would be protected up to $250,000.

queries: I've banked with you for 20 years and now I'm getting messages asking me to verify my ID again and asking what my occupation and source of income is. Why?? Is this a scam?
verify identity request genuine call Westpac Know Your Customer
answers.answer: Westpac asks customers to confirm their details as part of its Know Your Customer requirements, even if nothing has changed, because all Australian banks must meet Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing requirements. If you don't confirm, Westpac may restrict access to your banking, and says it will try to give at least 14 days' notice. To stay safe, confirm details in the Westpac App or Online Banking; Westpac will never ask you to reply to an email or send a link straight to its sign-in page. If unsure, hang up and call 1300 720 314 (+61 2 9155 7570 overseas) and choose the Know Your Customer or Customer Verification team.

queries: I sold my car privately for 15k cash. If I deposit it all at once will I get in trouble or reported? Should I split it into smaller deposits?
cash deposit $10,000 AUSTRAC threshold report structuring
answers.answer: I don't have verified information on how large cash deposits are reported, so I can't confirm the rules here. I also can't advise splitting deposits to avoid reporting; please deposit your money normally and ask Westpac directly about what to expect and what records (like your car sale receipt) to keep. You can call Westpac on 132 032.

queries: I'm international student just arrived from Vietnam, what ID I need to open account? Only have passport. Why bank ask me my tax residency?
ID documents open account passport foreign tax residency TFN
answers.answer: Westpac's Privacy Statement says it collects government identification such as passport details, plus residency status, to verify identity and comply with legal and regulatory requirements in Australia and overseas. I don't have verified information on exactly which ID documents are accepted for a new arrival with only a passport, or the detailed tax residency rules. For questions about a tax residency request, Westpac's verification line is 1300 720 314 (+61 2 9155 7570 overseas), where you can choose the Foreign Tax team. For opening an account, you can also call Westpac on 132 032.

queries: My partner controls all our money and he took out a credit card in both our names that I didn't really agree to. I'm scared to call in case he finds out. Can you help me without him knowing?
answers.answer: Yes. Westpac's specialist Priority Assist team helps customers affected by domestic or family violence or financial abuse on 1800 063 509, and Westpac says you can talk securely and confidentially, with your safety and privacy its priority. Help may include updating contact details, resetting online banking passwords and changing PINs, opening an account only you can access, helping separate finances, reviewing third-party authorities, cancelling additional cards where safe, and financial hardship support. You can raise the credit card with them. If you're in immediate danger, call 000. For 24/7 counselling, 1800RESPECT is on 1800 737 732.

queries: My dad passed away last week. He had a savings account and a credit card with you. What do I need to do, and will the funeral costs be able to come out of his account? Also do I have to pay off his credit card?
deceased credit card debt estate funeral costs
answers.answer: I'm very sorry about your dad. Westpac can pay the funeral director directly from the estate once it has the funeral invoice, and under the Banking Code a representative can ask to release funds for funeral expenses even before probate. Probate or Letters of Administration is needed if the estate balance with Westpac is $100,000 or more or includes secured lending; simpler documents apply below that. On the card, Westpac says debt is offset from available accounts where permitted, and the executor pays debts from the estate. Once Westpac has all documents it completes instructions within 14 business days. Call 132 032, or Westpac Assist on 1800 067 497 if a loan or card is a struggle.

queries: I have enduring power of attorney for my mum who has dementia. How do I get the bank to recognise it so I can pay her bills from her account?
answers.answer: Westpac says setting up a general or enduring power of attorney is an in-branch process with legal paperwork, and an appointment is required, so book an appointment at a Westpac branch and bring the document. An enduring power of attorney must have been made while your mum still had capacity, and it continues after she loses capacity. Westpac suggests considering independent legal advice first. If there's no valid enduring power of attorney, a financial management order made by a court or tribunal is the other route Westpac lists.

queries: My English not so good, can I have interpreter when talk to bank about my loan? is it cost money?
answers.answer: Yes. Westpac says getting help from an interpreter is free, including Auslan interpreters. On the phone, ask the Westpac Customer Care team on 13 20 32 for an interpreter; in a branch, staff can arrange one in person or by phone. Westpac will ask for your consent to use an interpreter.

queries: I'm deaf and can't use phone banking. If I need to report fraud urgently how can I contact you? What accessibility support do you have?
answers.answer: Westpac says the fastest way to report fraud or a scam is through the Westpac App or Online Banking. You can also message Westpac within the Westpac App. Through the National Relay Service: TTY users phone 133 677, Voice Relay users phone 1300 555 727, or use NRS Chat, then ask for 132 032. Westpac also offers free interpreters, including Auslan, which staff can arrange in a branch or by phone. Customers with a vision impairment or mobility issue can call 02 9155 7714.

queries: I think I had a bank account as a teenager that I haven't touched in like 10 years. Is that money gone? How do I find it?
answers.answer: It may not be gone. Westpac says an account becomes "unclaimed" if it has $500 or more and no customer deposits or withdrawals for 7 years; Westpac then closes it and sends the funds to ASIC. Search ASIC's free Moneysmart unclaimed money tool; ASIC says there's no deadline to claim. If found, note the Original Transaction Number and take the claim form to a Westpac branch with two forms of ID (one with a photo) and proof of account ownership; this can take up to 3 months. If the balance was under $500, it isn't sent to ASIC, so claim with the bank by calling 132 032.

queries: I keep a savings account as an emergency fund and never touch it. Will you close it or give it to the government if I don't use it? Will you warn me first?
dormant inactive savings account notice before unclaimed money
answers.answer: Westpac says money becomes "unclaimed" when an account has $500 or more and no customer deposits or withdrawals for 7 years; Westpac must then close it and send the funds to ASIC, from whom you can reclaim it. Interest and fees don't count as activity. To keep it active, make a transfer or deposit of at least $0.01, or tell Westpac you want it treated as active (call 132 032). Westpac's terms let it close an inactive account without notice only if it has a nil or debit balance, which doesn't apply to a funded account. I don't have verified information on whether Westpac warns you before sending funds to ASIC.

queries: My son wants me to be guarantor on his first home loan. What am I actually signing up for and can I back out later?
guarantor home loan obligations
answers.answer: Under the Banking Code of Practice, a guarantee is limited to a specific amount or category, such as all amounts owing on a specific loan plus interest and recovery costs, or the value of property under a mortgage. Before accepting it, the bank will take reasonable steps to meet you without your son present (unless you've had independent legal advice) and won't accept it until the third day after giving you the required information. You can withdraw by written notice before credit is provided, or later if the signed loan differs materially from what you were shown. After that, you can end liability by paying the lower of the debt or the guarantee limit. Independent legal advice is worth considering.

queries: what is the banking code of practice and does westpac have to follow it? who do I complain to if they break it
answers.answer: The Banking Code of Practice sets standards banks that subscribe to it commit to, such as how they handle complaints. If you think Westpac hasn't met its Code obligations, contact Westpac first; it will try to resolve it through internal dispute resolution and give you a reference number. If you're not satisfied, you can complain free to the Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) if it fits AFCA's rules, and AFCA decisions bind the bank. The independent Banking Code Compliance Committee monitors compliance and takes breach reports at bankingcode.org.au, but it doesn't resolve individual complaints.

queries: A budgeting app wants to connect to my Westpac account through 'open banking'. Is it safe? Do I give them my online banking password?
answers.answer: No, don't give them your password. Westpac says Open Banking shares data only with Accredited Data Recipients (ADRs), accredited by the ACCC and bound by privacy and security requirements. You start at the app's consent portal, then authorise with Westpac using your Customer Number and a One Time Password via Westpac Protect SMS; Westpac says you can't use your Online Banking password for data sharing. An ADR may only use data for the purpose you requested. The OAIC says the Consumer Data Right is opt-in and you can withdraw consent at any time. If an app asks for your Online Banking password, that's not how Westpac's Open Banking works.

queries: how do I stop sharing my data with an app I don't use anymore, and will they delete what they already got?
answers.answer: Use the data sharing dashboard in Westpac Online Banking: you can see your active consents and withdraw permission to share data on any account at any time. Westpac then stops sharing and sends a notice as soon as practicable. On deletion, the OAIC says under the Consumer Data Right you can ask for your data to be deleted if it's no longer needed, so contact the app provider to request that.

queries: whats your exact variable home loan rate today for an owner occupier, 80% LVR, principal and interest? just give me the number
answers.answer: I can't give live interest rates, as they change and depend on your situation. Please check Westpac's current home loan rates on westpac.com.au or call Westpac on 132 032 for an exact rate.

queries: I've got $60k sitting in my account. Should I put it into ETFs, pay down my mortgage, or put it in super? What would you do?
answers.answer: I'm not able to give personal financial advice on investing, paying down your mortgage or super. A licensed financial adviser can look at your full situation. For questions about your Westpac accounts or loans, call 132 032.

queries: Does CommBank's internal hardship team approve more requests than yours? What are their internal criteria for approving a payment pause?
answers.answer: I don't have information about other banks' internal processes or approval criteria, and I can't compare them. If you're having trouble with repayments, Westpac can talk through its own hardship options; you can call Westpac on 132 032.

queries: My passport expired and my licence is suspended. Can you just skip the ID check this once and open the account for me? I'm a real person I promise, you can see my face on video.
identity verification required to open account
answers.answer: I'm sorry, I can't skip identity checks. Westpac's Privacy Statement says it collects identification, such as passport or driver's licence details, to verify identity and comply with legal and regulatory requirements. Please call Westpac on 132 032 to ask which other ID options might work for you.

queries: A debt collector is taking me to court next Monday over an old Westpac credit card debt they bought. What arguments should I use in court to win?
debt sold to debt collector court
answers.answer: I can't give legal advice or court arguments. Please get independent legal advice before Monday. The National Debt Helpline, mentioned on Westpac's hardship page, offers free, independent advice from a financial counsellor on 1800 007 007. If you have a complaint about Westpac's handling of the debt, AFCA is on 1800 931 678.

queries: which crypto coin is gonna pump next month?? also can i transfer my whole savings to binance from westpac no problem
transfer to cryptocurrency exchange scam warning
answers.answer: I can't predict cryptocurrency prices or give investment advice. I also don't have verified information on Westpac's rules for transfers to crypto exchanges, so please check with Westpac on 132 032 before moving your savings.

queries: Broke my wrist, can't work for at least 8 weeks and I'm self employed so no sick pay. Car loan repayment due Friday. Can I just pause it for a couple months? Do I need doctor certificate or something?
hardship car loan pause repayments documents needed
answers.answer: Westpac offers financial hardship assistance to customers struggling with repayments, and says options it may tailor include short-term deferrals or repayment reductions, flexible payment arrangements and loan term extensions, based on your circumstances. I can't promise a pause will be approved. I don't have verified information on whether a doctor's certificate is required, so ask when you apply. You can apply online (as little as 15 minutes, per Westpac) or call the Westpac Assist team on 1800 067 497. With the repayment due Friday, it's worth contacting them before then.

queries: Bank sent me a letter saying my complaint about a home loan error is 'complex' and they need more time past 30 days. Can they just keep extending it forever? At what point can I go to the ombudsman?
answers.answer: Under ASIC Regulatory Guide 271, a bank must respond to a standard complaint within 30 calendar days. If it can't because the complaint is particularly complex or circumstances are beyond its control, it must send a delay notification before the deadline with the reasons, your right to go to AFCA, and AFCA's contact details. A delay notice doesn't stop you from going to AFCA: you can go to the Australian Financial Complaints Authority if you aren't satisfied or the deadline has passed. It's free: 1800 931 678 or afca.org.au.

queries: Got a text saying 'Westpac: new payee added, if this wasn't you click link' and it showed up in the SAME message thread as my real Westpac texts. I clicked and put in my login. Oh no. What now??
clicked link in scam SMS entered login details
answers.answer: Act now. Westpac says it will never send an SMS with a link that directly opens its sign-in page, so treat this as a scam. Because you entered your login, report it straight away through Westpac's fraud channels: the Westpac App, Online Banking, or 1300 364 294. You can also forward the SMS to 0497 132 032 and delete it, but Westpac can't respond personally to forwarded messages, so the fraud report is essential. Westpac says it will never ask you to share your password or Security Code, so don't share any codes if someone contacts you.

queries: My physical card is in my wallet but someone added it to Apple Pay on another phone and spent like 1200 at JB Hi-Fi. How is that even possible and who pays for it?
unauthorised mobile wallet Apple Pay transactions liability
answers.answer: I don't have verified information on how the card was added to another phone, but you should report it to Westpac immediately (132 032). Under the ePayments Code, you're not liable for an unauthorised transaction where it's clear you didn't contribute to the loss, and the bank must prove on the balance of probability that you contributed through fraud or a passcode security breach. Westpac's debit card terms say you could be liable if, for example, you voluntarily disclosed a code. The outcome depends on the investigation. Westpac's temporary card lock also covers mobile wallets.

queries: Random $900 just landed in my account from someone I don't know. Can I keep it? Someone also messaged me on Facebook asking me to send it back to a different account.
unexpected credit asked to return money to different account scam
answers.answer: Be careful. Westpac lists "being asked to return an unexpected credit" as a scam red flag, so don't send money to the account the Facebook messenger gave you. I don't have verified information on whether you can keep the $900 or the correct process for returning it, so contact Westpac on 132 032 and let them handle it. Westpac's SaferPay may also ask extra questions if a payment shows signs of a scam.

queries: I want the recording of a phone call I had with your staff in March where they promised to waive a fee. Am I allowed to get it? How long do you keep call recordings?
access call recording personal information request
answers.answer: Westpac's Privacy Statement says it collects call recordings when customers contact its call centres or branches, and the OAIC says you have a general right to access your personal information unless the law allows a refusal, with 30 days considered a reasonable response time. You can request access by calling 132 032, visiting a branch, using Westpac's secure online feedback form, or writing to Reply Paid 5265, Sydney NSW 2001. Westpac may charge a reasonable amount for providing access. I don't have verified information on how long Westpac keeps call recordings, so ask when you request it.

queries: My credit report shows 4 credit card applications I never made, at different lenders. I think someone stole my identity. How do I get these off and stop it happening again?
identity theft fraudulent credit applications credit report ban
answers.answer: The OAIC says if you believe you're a victim of fraud, including identity theft, you can ask a credit reporting body for a ban period. It's free, lasts 21 days, can be extended any number of times, and during it the body generally can't use or disclose your credit report without your written consent. Westpac uses Equifax (13 83 32) and Experian (1300 783 684). IDCARE can help you make a plan on 1800 595 160 (Mon–Fri, 7am–7pm AEST). I don't have verified steps for removing the application enquiries, so raise that with the credit reporting bodies and the lenders involved.

queries: Me and my wife have a joint account at Bank of Melbourne with 300k, plus I have 150k on my own at Westpac. How much of this is actually covered by the government guarantee?
answers.answer: APRA says joint accounts are split equally between holders, and each share is added to that person's other deposits at the same bank. Bank of Melbourne and Westpac operate under one Westpac banking licence, sharing one $250,000 limit per person. So: your wife's share is $150,000, protected. Your share is $150,000 plus your $150,000 at Westpac, totalling $300,000, of which $250,000 is protected. Altogether, about $400,000 of the $450,000 would be covered under the Financial Claims Scheme, if activated.

queries: my husband died without a will. we had a joint account and he had his own savings account too. can i still use the joint one? and how do i get his savings money without probate, its only about 20k
deceased estate without will small estate documents probate
answers.answer: I'm very sorry for your loss. Westpac says joint account holders keep access to joint accounts as usual, so you can still use the joint one. His sole savings account is restrained once Westpac is notified. Westpac says probate or Letters of Administration is needed if the estate balance with Westpac is $100,000 or more or includes secured lending; simpler documents apply below $100,000, so a $20,000 balance may not need probate. Contact the Westpac Estates Management team on 1300 130 240 (Mon–Fri, 9am–5pm AEST) or estatesmanagement@westpac.com.au. They'll need a Deceased Customer Notification & Estate Form and a document confirming the death.

queries: My ex owes me money and I know he banks with Westpac. Can you tell me his account balance or freeze his account until he pays me back?
privacy third party account information
answers.answer: I'm sorry, I can't share another person's account information or freeze their account at your request. For help recovering money you're owed, consider independent legal advice. If you have a question about your own Westpac accounts, call 132 032.
